Method of Attack: Phishing links, domains, and mass mailing campaigns impersonating representatives of organizations
Distribution of malware designed to steal information and remote access tools
Use of malware to collect sensitive information like authentication data from browsers, email, and FTP clients
Tricking companies into making payments to bank accounts controlled by attackers via business email compromise (BEC) scams
Use of social engineering and changing payment details to redirect funds
Automated email sending using Gammadyne and Turbo mass mailers
Monitoring email openings using MailChimp automation platform
Use of previously compromised inboxes to send phishing emails
Impacted Systems: Private and government sector organizations in more than 150 countries
